connectorUiConfig.title: WhoisXML API Domain Feeds (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
Brings three WhoisXML API data feeds into Microsoft Sentinel: **Newly Registered Domains 2.0**, **Threat Intelligence** (malicious domains) and **Bulk Registration Risk** (typosquatting groups). The solution's analytics rules match them against your DNS, web proxy, endpoint and email logs.

The connector polls WhoisXML API's feed service at `feeds-api.whoisxmlapi.com`, which checks your API key with WhoisXML API's download server on every delivery, so you receive only the feeds your subscription includes.

Newly registered domains usually reach the feed within one to two days of registration. The Threat Intelligence feed is delivered as daily changes, with every active domain re-sent at least every 10 days so the rules always see the full list. Its listings carry a threat type but no confidence score, and a domain stays listed for up to 90 days after WhoisXML API last observed it, so the rules grade severity by threat type and by how recently the domain was seen.

sampleQueries.description: Newly registered domains received in the last day
Active threat intelligence domains by threat type
sampleQueries.query:
WhoisXMLThreatDomains_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend StateKey = FeedDate + FeedVersion * 1s
| summarize arg_max(StateKey, ChangeType) by DomainName, ThreatType
| where ChangeType != "removed"
| summarize Domains = count() by ThreatType

sampleQueries.description: Largest typosquatting groups received in the last day
sampleQueries.query:
WhoisXMLTyposquatting_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| summarize Members = make_set(DomainName, 10), GroupSize = max(GroupSize) by FeedDate, GroupNumber
| top 20 by GroupSize desc

sampleQueries.description: Ingestion volume by table, last 7 days
sampleQueries.query:
union WhoisXMLNRD_CL, WhoisXMLThreatDomains_CL, WhoisXMLTyposquatting_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize GB = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9, 3) by Type, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

parameters.text: IP allowlist: if your WhoisXML API account restricts its API key to an IP allowlist, add 44.194.11.104 to it first. Requests reach WhoisXML API from that address on your behalf, so anyone who holds your key can then retrieve your feeds through this connector. Keep the key secret. WhoisXML API will tell you before this address changes.

Cost: with all three feeds enabled, expect about 0.12 GB of ingestion a day, plus about 1 GB of history spread over the first day after you connect. The Threat Intelligence feed is most of it. Use a separate API key for each workspace. History is kept per API key, not per workspace: a workspace connected with a key that another workspace already polls for the same feeds and tier receives no history of its own, only whatever of that key's history is still being sent when it connects; one that reconnects while another keeps polling does not receive what it missed; and an outage of more than about 30 minutes can cost one of them a whole day's release. The Ingestion volume by table sample query shows your actual volume. To stop a feed's ingestion, select Disconnect, clear that feed, then select Connect.
Trial: to request a trial key for the WhoisXML API feeds, write to sales@whoisxmlapi.com.

properties.description: WhoisXMLNRDResolvedInDns_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0
Identifies hosts that resolved a domain WhoisXML API lists as newly registered in the last 14 days. New domains are common in phishing, malware delivery and command and control.
properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Newly registered domain resolved by internal host

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{DomainName}} appeared in the WhoisXML API newly registered domains feed and was resolved {{QueryCount}} times in the last hour.

properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Newly registered domain resolved by internal host

properties.description: Identifies inbound email delivered to a mailbox that links to a domain WhoisXML API lists as newly registered in the last 14 days. Links to very young domains are a strong phishing signal.
properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Newly registered domain linked in delivered email
properties.query:
// Defender XDR email tables can reach the workspace late; set from the live test's measurement
let ingestion_delay = 1h;
let rule_lookback = 1h;
let nrd_lookback = 14d;
let Allowlisted = union
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLDomainAllowlist') | project Domain = tolower(tostring(SearchKey))),
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLDomainAllowlistCustom') | project Domain = tolower(tostring(SearchKey)));
let UrlRows = materialize(
    EmailUrlInfo
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(2 * ingestion_delay + rule_lookback)
    | where isnotempty(UrlDomain)
    | extend UrlIngest = coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated)
    | extend Fqdn = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", UrlDomain))
    | extend Labels = split(Fqdn, ".")
    | extend LabelCount = array_length(Labels)
    | extend Cand2 = iff(LabelCount >= 2, strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 2]), ".", tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 1])), "")
    | extend Cand3 = iff(LabelCount >= 3, strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 3]), ".", Cand2), "")
    | project UrlTime = TimeGenerated, UrlIngest, NetworkMessageId, Url, Fqdn, Cand2, Cand3, UrlLocation
);
let Candidates = union
    (UrlRows | where isnotempty(Cand2) | distinct Domain = Cand2),
    (UrlRows | where isnotempty(Cand3) | distinct Domain = Cand3)
    | distinct Domain;
let NewDomains = WhoisXMLNRD_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(nrd_lookback)
    | where Reason == "added"
    | where DomainName in (Candidates)
    // Allowlisted domains drop out through an anti-join from the small side: an in() filter fails above 1,000,000
    // values, which an imported list can reach
    | join kind=leftanti Allowlisted on $left.DomainName == $right.Domain
    | summarize FeedDate = max(FeedDate) by DomainName;
// A message's URL and delivery rows reach the workspace separately, in either order, so both tables are read over
// the same wider span, and each joined pair is kept only by the run that follows the later of its two rows.
// Defender streams a further delivery row whenever a message's verdict or location changes; only the first counts
let Delivered = EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(2 * ingestion_delay + rule_lookback)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | extend DeliveryIngest = coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated)
    | project NetworkMessageId, DeliveryIngest, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, Subject, DeliveryLocation
    | summarize arg_min(DeliveryIngest, *) by NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress;
NewDomains
| join kind=inner (
    UrlRows
    | extend Candidate = pack_array(Cand2, Cand3)
    | mv-expand Candidate to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(Candidate)
) on $left.DomainName == $right.Candidate
| join kind=inner Delivered on NetworkMessageId
| where max_of(UrlIngest, DeliveryIngest) > ago(rule_lookback)
| summarize
    StartTime = min(UrlTime),
    EndTime = max(UrlTime),
    Urls = make_set(Url, 10),
    UrlLocations = make_set(UrlLocation, 5)
    by NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, Subject, DomainName, FeedDate
| extend
    Url = tostring(Urls[0]),
    RecipientName = tostring(split(RecipientEmailAddress, "@")[0]),
    RecipientUpnSuffix = tostring(split(RecipientEmailAddress, "@")[1])

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: A delivered email from {{SenderFromAddress}} contains a link to a domain that WhoisXML API lists as newly registered.
alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Email to {{RecipientEmailAddress}} links to newly registered domain {{DomainName}}

properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Newly registered domain linked in delivered email

properties.description: WhoisXMLNRDLinkClicked_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Identifies users who clicked a link in email, Teams or Office apps to a domain WhoisXML API lists as newly registered in the last 14 days, where the click was allowed or the user clicked through a warning.
properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - User clicked link to newly registered domain
properties.query:
// Defender XDR click events can reach the workspace late; set from the live test's measurement
let ingestion_delay = 1h;
let rule_lookback = 1h;
let nrd_lookback = 14d;
// A user and domain pair this rule alerted on is not alerted on again for this long
let dedupe_lookback = 7d;
let Allowlisted = union
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLDomainAllowlist') | project Domain = tolower(tostring(SearchKey))),
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLDomainAllowlistCustom') | project Domain = tolower(tostring(SearchKey)));
let AlreadyAlerted = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(dedupe_lookback)
    | where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
    | extend Details = todynamic(tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]))
    | where tostring(Details.WxaRule[0]) == "R3"
    | project AlertKey = strcat(tolower(tostring(Details.WxaUser[0])), "|", tostring(Details.WxaDomain[0]));
let Clicks = materialize(
    UrlClickEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(ingestion_delay + rule_lookback)
    | where coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) > ago(rule_lookback)
    | where ActionType == "ClickAllowed" or IsClickedThrough == true
    | extend ClickHost = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", tostring(parse_url(Url).Host)))
    | where isnotempty(ClickHost)
    | extend Labels = split(ClickHost, ".")
    | extend LabelCount = array_length(Labels)
    | extend Cand2 = iff(LabelCount >= 2, strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 2]), ".", tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 1])), "")
    | extend Cand3 = iff(LabelCount >= 3, strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 3]), ".", Cand2), "")
    | project ClickTime = TimeGenerated, AccountUpn, Url, ClickHost, Cand2, Cand3, Workload, ActionType, IsClickedThrough, IPAddress, NetworkMessageId
);
let Candidates = union
    (Clicks | where isnotempty(Cand2) | distinct Domain = Cand2),
    (Clicks | where isnotempty(Cand3) | distinct Domain = Cand3)
    | distinct Domain;
WhoisXMLNRD_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(nrd_lookback)
| where Reason == "added"
| where DomainName in (Candidates)
// Allowlisted domains drop out through an anti-join from the small side: an in() filter fails above 1,000,000
// values, which an imported list can reach
| join kind=leftanti Allowlisted on $left.DomainName == $right.Domain
| summarize FeedDate = max(FeedDate) by DomainName
| join kind=inner (
    Clicks
    | extend Candidate = pack_array(Cand2, Cand3)
    | mv-expand Candidate to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(Candidate)
) on $left.DomainName == $right.Candidate
| summarize
    StartTime = min(ClickTime),
    EndTime = max(ClickTime),
    ClickCount = count(),
    Workloads = make_set(Workload, 3),
    ClickedThrough = max(toint(IsClickedThrough)),
    arg_max(ClickTime, Url, IPAddress, NetworkMessageId)
    by AccountUpn, DomainName, FeedDate
| where strcat(tolower(AccountUpn), "|", DomainName) !in (AlreadyAlerted)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(AccountUpn, "@")[0]),
    AccountUpnSuffix = tostring(split(AccountUpn, "@")[1]),
    WxaRule = "R3"

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: {{AccountUpn}} clicked a link to newly registered domain {{DomainName}}

properties.description: Identifies hosts that resolved a domain listed in the WhoisXML API Threat Intelligence feed. Severity depends on the threat type, how recently WhoisXML API observed the domain, and whether it sits under a widely used domain other than a hosting platform.
properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Threat intelligence domain resolved by internal host

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{DomainName}} is listed in the WhoisXML API Threat Intelligence feed as {{ThreatTypeList}} and was resolved inside the estate.

properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Threat intelligence domain resolved by internal host

properties.description: Identifies endpoint connections and web proxy requests to a domain listed in the WhoisXML API Threat Intelligence feed, using Defender for Endpoint, ASIM web session and CEF proxy logs.
properties.displayName: WhoisXML API - Connection to threat intelligence domain from endpoint or proxy
properties.query:
let ingestion_delay = 30m;
let rule_lookback = 1h;
let ti_lookback = 14d;
let high_types = dynamic(["c2", "malware", "phishing", "botnet"]);
let recent = 14d;
let aging = 30d;
// Listings under a registered domain ranked in the top 100,000 are informational only, unless it is a hosting platform
let popular_rank = 100000;
// Host part of a URL or a bare host name; tolerates a missing scheme
let host_regex = @"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\-]*://)?(?:[^@/]*@)?([^:/?#]+)";
let Allowlisted = union
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLDomainAllowlist') | project Domain = tolower(tostring(SearchKey))),
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLDomainAllowlistCustom') | project Domain = tolower(tostring(SearchKey)))
    | where isnotempty(Domain);
// Hosting platforms (free website hosts, site builders, dynamic DNS), where each subdomain is a different party's site
let HostingPlatformList = union
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLHostingPlatforms') | project Domain = trim_end(@"\.", trim(@"\s+", tolower(tostring(SearchKey))))),
    (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLHostingPlatformsCustom') | project Domain = trim_end(@"\.", trim(@"\s+", tolower(tostring(SearchKey)))))
    | where isnotempty(Domain);
// At most 100,000 platforms, well inside the 1,000,000 values an in() filter allows
let HostingPlatforms = toscalar(HostingPlatformList | summarize make_set(Domain, 100000));
// The hour's connections, read twice: once for every destination host, then again for the clients of the hosts
// that matched
let Activity = union isfuzzy=true
        (DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated >= ago(ingestion_delay + rule_lookback)
        | where coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) > ago(rule_lookback)
        | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
        | where ActionType !has "ConnectionFailed"
        | project
            EventTime = TimeGenerated,
            RawHost = RemoteUrl,
            Url = RemoteUrl,
            SrcIpAddr = LocalIP,
            SrcHostname = DeviceName,
            SrcUsername = InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
            ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
            LogSource = "DeviceNetworkEvents"),
        (_Im_WebSession(starttime=ago(ingestion_delay + rule_lookback))
        | where coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) > ago(rule_lookback)
        | project
            EventTime = TimeGenerated,
            RawHost = iff(Url startswith "/", tostring(column_ifexists("DstFQDN", "")), Url),
            Url,
            SrcIpAddr,
            SrcHostname,
            SrcUsername,
            ProcessName = "",
            LogSource = "ASIM web session"),
        (CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated >= ago(ingestion_delay + rule_lookback)
        | where coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) > ago(rule_lookback)
        | where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
        | project
            EventTime = TimeGenerated,
            RawHost = iff(isnotempty(DestinationHostName), DestinationHostName, RequestURL),
            Url = RequestURL,
            SrcIpAddr = SourceIP,
            SrcHostname = SourceHostName,
            SrcUsername = SourceUserName,
            ProcessName = "",
            LogSource = strcat(DeviceVendor, " ", DeviceProduct))
    | extend Host = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", extract(host_regex, 1, RawHost)))
    | where isnotempty(Host);
// One row per destination host with only its time span and count, summarised before materialize: per-client
// detail for every host would exhaust the query's memory in estates that reach millions of hosts an hour
let ActivityByHost = materialize(
    Activity
    | summarize
        StartTime = min(EventTime),
        EndTime = max(EventTime),
        Events = count()
        by Host
    | extend Labels = split(Host, ".")
    | extend LabelCount = array_length(Labels)
    | extend Cand2 = iff(LabelCount >= 2, strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 2]), ".", tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 1])), "")
    | extend Cand3 = iff(LabelCount >= 3, strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount - 3]), ".", Cand2), "")
    | project-away Labels, LabelCount
);
let Candidates = union
    (ActivityByHost | where isnotempty(Cand2) | distinct Domain = Cand2),
    (ActivityByHost | where isnotempty(Cand3) | distinct Domain = Cand3)
    | distinct Domain;
let NCand = toscalar(Candidates | count);
let Feed = WhoisXMLThreatDomains_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(ti_lookback)
    | extend FLabels = split(DomainName, ".")
    | extend FCount = array_length(FLabels)
    | extend F2 = iff(FCount >= 2, strcat(tostring(FLabels[FCount - 2]), ".", tostring(FLabels[FCount - 1])), "")
    | extend F3 = iff(FCount >= 3, strcat(tostring(FLabels[FCount - 3]), ".", tostring(FLabels[FCount - 2]), ".", tostring(FLabels[FCount - 1])), "")
    | project-away FLabels, FCount;
let ActiveThreats = materialize(
    union
        (Feed | where NCand <= 900000 | where DomainName in (Candidates) or F3 in (Candidates)),
        (Feed | where NCand > 900000
            | extend Key = pack_array(DomainName, F3)
            | mv-expand Key to typeof(string)
            | join kind=inner hint.shufflekey=Key (Candidates | project Key = Domain) on Key
            | project-away Key, Key1)
    // An allowlisted registered domain also covers every host listed under it. One anti-join from the small side per
    // name (the listing, its last two labels, its last three): an in() filter fails above 1,000,000 values
    | join kind=leftanti Allowlisted on $left.DomainName == $right.Domain
    | join kind=leftanti Allowlisted on $left.F2 == $right.Domain
    | join kind=leftanti Allowlisted on $left.F3 == $right.Domain
    // A listing under a hosting platform (its last two to four labels, the most specific entry first) is a different
    // party's site and keeps its severity; the platform itself and its own www host (www.weebly.com) do not
    | extend Labels = split(DomainName, ".")
    | extend F4 = iff(array_length(Labels) >= 4, strcat(tostring(Labels[array_length(Labels) - 4]), ".", F3), "")
    | extend Platform = iff(F4 in (HostingPlatforms), F4, iff(F3 in (HostingPlatforms), F3, iff(F2 in (HostingPlatforms), F2, "")))
    | extend OwnHost = array_length(Labels) == array_length(split(Platform, ".")) + 1 and tostring(Labels[0]) == "www"
    | extend Hosted = isnotempty(Platform) and DomainName != Platform and not(OwnHost)
    | project-away Labels, F4
    | extend StateKey = FeedDate + FeedVersion * 1s
    | summarize arg_max(StateKey, ChangeType, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ParentRank, IsPublicSuffix, Hosted) by DomainName, ThreatType
    | where ChangeType != "removed"
    | summarize
        ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType, 10),
        FeedFirstSeen = min(FirstSeen),
        FeedLastSeen = max(LastSeen),
        ParentRank = max(ParentRank),
        SuffixListing = max(toint(IsPublicSuffix)),
        HostedListing = max(toint(Hosted))
        by DomainName
    | extend IsHighType = array_length(set_intersect(ThreatTypes, high_types)) > 0
    | extend LastSeenAge = now() - FeedLastSeen
    | extend AlertSeverity = case(
        ParentRank between (1 .. popular_rank) and HostedListing == 0, "Informational",
        IsHighType and LastSeenAge <= recent, "High",
        LastSeenAge <= aging, "Medium",
        "Low")
    | extend ThreatTypeList = strcat_array(ThreatTypes, ", ")
);
let MatchKeys = ActiveThreats | project DomainName;
// A listing that is itself a public suffix (mysynology.net, s3.amazonaws.com) matches only its own name: the hosts under it belong to unrelated parties
let SuffixKeys = ActiveThreats | where SuffixListing == 1 | project DomainName;
let Resolved = ActivityByHost
    | where Host in (MatchKeys) or Cand2 in (MatchKeys) or Cand3 in (MatchKeys)
    | extend Candidate = set_union(pack_array(Host), pack_array(Cand2, Cand3))
    | mv-expand Candidate to typeof(string)
    | where Candidate in (MatchKeys)
    | where Candidate == Host or Candidate !in (SuffixKeys);
let MatchedHosts = Resolved | distinct Host;
// Clients only for the hosts that matched, joined from the small side: an in() filter fails above 1,000,000
// values, which one domain with generated subdomains can reach
let ClientsByHost = MatchedHosts
    | join kind=rightsemi Activity on Host
    // Proxy logs often leave SrcHostname empty; the client's IP address stands in for it
    | extend SrcClient = coalesce(SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr)
    | summarize
        HostHll = hll_if(SrcClient, isnotempty(SrcClient)),
        SourceHosts = make_set_if(SrcClient, isnotempty(SrcClient), 20),
        SourceIps = make_set(SrcIpAddr, 20),
        Users = make_set(SrcUsername, 20),
        Processes = make_set(ProcessName, 10),
        LogSources = make_set(LogSource, 5),
        SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 5)
        by Host;
ActiveThreats
| join kind=inner Resolved on $left.DomainName == $right.Candidate
| join kind=inner ClientsByHost on Host
| summarize
    StartTime = min(StartTime),
    EndTime = max(EndTime),
    EventCount = sum(Events),
    HostHll = hll_merge(HostHll),
    arg_max(Events, SourceHosts, SourceIps, Users, Processes, LogSources, SampleUrls)
    by DomainName, ThreatTypeList, AlertSeverity, FeedFirstSeen, FeedLastSeen, ParentRank
| extend HostCount = dcount_hll(HostHll)
| extend
    SourceHost = tostring(SourceHosts[0]),
    SourceIp = tostring(SourceIps[0]),
    AccountName = tostring(Users[0]),
    Url = tostring(SampleUrls[0])
| project-away HostHll, Events

properties.query:
let feed_lookback = 14d;
let BrandKeywords = toscalar(
    union
        (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLBrandKeywords') | project SearchKey),
        (_GetWatchlist('WhoisXMLBrandKeywordsCustom') | project SearchKey)
    | extend Keyword = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(SearchKey)))
    | where strlen(Keyword) >= 4 and Keyword !startswith "example"
    | summarize make_set(Keyword, 200)
);
WhoisXMLTyposquatting_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(feed_lookback)
| summarize arg_max(FeedDate, GroupNumber, GroupMemberNumber, GroupSize, DomainNameUtf) by DomainName
| extend Keywords = BrandKeywords
| mv-apply Keyword = Keywords to typeof(string) on (
    where DomainName contains Keyword or DomainNameUtf contains Keyword
    | take 1
)
| project FeedDate, DomainName, DomainNameUtf, MatchedKeyword = Keyword, GroupNumber, GroupMemberNumber, GroupSize
| order by FeedDate desc, GroupNumber asc

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The WhoisXML API solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests three WhoisXML API feeds (Newly Registered Domains 2.0, Threat Intelligence and Bulk Registration Risk) and matches them against your DNS, web proxy, endpoint and email logs.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Codeless Connector Framework

  2. Data Collection Rules

Prerequisites: a WhoisXML API key with a subscription to the feeds you enable. Rules use the ASIM DNS and Web Session parsers and Microsoft Defender XDR tables where present.

Data Connectors: 1, Analytic Rules: 6, Hunting Queries: 3, Watchlists: 3
